## 🤖 FTC Testing & Verification Checklist
Before submitting this merge request, you **must** complete and verify the following steps on the physical robot or in unit tests:

- [ ] **Compilation:** The code builds and runs successfully in Android Studio without layout or manifest errors.
- [ ] **Spotless Applied:** I ran `./gradlew :TeamCode:spotlessApply` locally to ensure the code matches our styling parameters.
- [ ] **Unit Tested:** All JUnit/Mockito unit tests pass locally on my desktop JVM.
- [ ] **Robot Verification:** The code was deployed to a physical Control Hub on a fresh battery (>13.0V) and verified on the practice tiles.
- [ ] **Telemetry Check:** Telemetry logs clear smoothly and do not spam or freeze the Driver Station interface.
